item.title: How to create a custom error in JavaScript
item.description: Creating custom error classes allows you to handle different error types distinctly and add application-specific context to errors. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built custom error hierarchies for complex enterprise applications. The most effective solution is to extend the built-in Error class to create custom error types with additional properties. This approach enables precise error handling and better debugging with domain-specific error information.
